purpose: Define when cross-system benchmark observations may be published as comparative evidence.
forbidden: claiming external comparison before external challenger execution

claim_levels.HARNESS_VALIDATED: Benchmark machinery passed controlled validation only.
claim_levels.EXTERNAL_RUN_OBSERVED: At least one registered external challenger executed under the protocol.
claim_levels.COMPARATIVE_RESULT_VERIFIED: A complete comparative result capsule passed verification.
claim_levels.REPLICATED_RESULT: The comparative result was reproduced in a separately declared execution environment.
